title: Severe waterlogging at Andheri subway after 3 hours of heavy rain
summary: Andheri subway flooded completely. Traffic diverted to Western Express Highway. Local trains running late by 20-30 mins.
full_description: Continuous heavy rainfall for 3 hours caused severe waterlogging at Andheri subway. Water level reached 4 feet. BMC deployed pumps but drainage is slow due to high tide.

ai_analysis.risk_summary: Urban flooding in low-lying areas
ai_analysis.recommended_action: Avoid Andheri subway, use Jogeshwari-Vikhroli Link Road

title: Chemical factory fire in Thane MIDC area spreading rapidly
summary: Major fire at chemical storage unit in Thane. Toxic smoke rising. 8 fire engines fighting blaze.
full_description: Fire broke out at Apex Chemicals in Thane MIDC. Thick black smoke visible from Ghodbunder Road. 8 fire engines deployed.

sources.snippet: Chemical factory blaze in Thane MIDC

ai_analysis.risk_summary: Toxic smoke hazard, potential explosion risk
ai_analysis.recommended_action: Close windows, avoid Thane-Mumbai corridor, wear N95 masks

title: Old building collapse in Thane West, 15 feared trapped
summary: G+3 residential building collapsed in Rabodi area. NDRF and Fire Brigade on site. Rescue operations in progress.
full_description: A 40-year-old building collapsed in Rabodi area. 15 residents trapped. NDRF rescue team deployed. 5 rescued so far.

ai_analysis.risk_summary: Structural instability in adjacent buildings
ai_analysis.recommended_action: Avoid Rabodi area. Clear paths for ambulances.

title: Major Landslide on Mumbai-Pune Expressway near Lonavala
summary: Debris blocking all lanes towards Mumbai. Traffic diverted to Old Highway.
full_description: Massive landslide at Khandala ghat section. Boulders and mud blocking Mumbai-bound lanes. Traffic diverted.

ai_analysis.risk_summary: Potential for further slides due to rain
ai_analysis.recommended_action: Postpone non-essential travel between Mumbai and Pune.

title: Gas Leak reported in Navi Mumbai Industrial Area (Taloja)
summary: Foul smell across Taloja and Kharghar. Fire brigade investigating. Stay indoors.
full_description: Suspected ammonia gas leak from industrial unit in Taloja MIDC. Air quality monitoring active.

sources.snippet: Fire brigade responding to gas leak

ai_analysis.risk_summary: Ammonia inhalation risk
ai_analysis.recommended_action: Stay indoors. Close all windows.

title: Cyclone Warning: Deep Depression approaching Palghar coast
summary: IMD issues Red Alert for Palghar. Wind speeds of 90kmph expected.
full_description: IMD upgraded the weather system. Red Alert issued for Palghar district. Fishermen warned.

ai_analysis.risk_summary: High wind damage risk
ai_analysis.recommended_action: Stay away from coast. Secure loose objects.

title: Bridge crack discovered on Ghatkopar-Mankhurd link road
summary: Structural crack found on bridge. Bridge closed for heavy vehicles.
full_description: BMC engineers discovered a 2-inch wide structural crack on the Ghatkopar-Mankhurd bridge.

ai_analysis.risk_summary: Structural failure risk for heavy vehicles
ai_analysis.recommended_action: Avoid bridge if driving truck or bus.

title: Water contamination in Malad East - 50 people hospitalized
summary: 50 residents hospitalized with gastroenteritis. Water contamination suspected.
full_description: Residents of Malad East hospitalized with vomiting. BMC suspects municipal water contamination.

ai_analysis.risk_summary: Waterborne disease outbreak
ai_analysis.recommended_action: Boil water before drinking in Malad East.

title: Fire at high-rise in Borivali West - 12 floors affected
summary: Major fire in 20-story building. 5 rescued via ladders. Electrical short circuit suspected.
full_description: Fire broke out on 8th floor of Siddharth Heights. Fire spread through duct to multiple floors.

ai_analysis.risk_summary: Smoke inhalation primary risk
ai_analysis.recommended_action: Avoid Borivali West. Clear path for fire engines.

title: Building wall collapse in Kurla due to metro excavation
summary: Compound wall collapsed in Kurla East. MMRDA halts work.
full_description: 30-foot compound wall of Shanti Niwas collapsed during metro line 4 excavation.

ai_analysis.risk_summary: Foundation risk to adjacent structures
ai_analysis.recommended_action: Residents should report any new cracks immediately.

title: Heatwave alert: IMD warns of 43°C in Mumbai for next 48 hours
summary: IMD issues orange alert for extreme heat in Mumbai and surrounding districts. Schools advised early dismissal.
full_description: Temperatures in Mumbai expected to reach 43°C over the next 48 hours. Heat index could feel like 48°C. BMC has set up 15 hydration stations.

ai_analysis.risk_summary: Heat stroke risk for elderly and outdoor workers
ai_analysis.recommended_action: Stay hydrated, avoid outdoor activity 11AM-4PM, wear light clothing.

title: Major accident on Eastern Freeway — 8 vehicles involved
summary: Pile-up accident on Eastern Freeway near Ghatkopar exit. 3 injured. Traffic at standstill.
full_description: Chain collision involving 2 trucks and 6 cars on Eastern Freeway. Road blocked for 2 km. Ambulances on site.

ai_analysis.risk_summary: Traffic disruption, possible fuel spill
ai_analysis.recommended_action: Avoid Eastern Freeway. Use Sion-Panvel Highway instead.

title: Severe flooding in Dadar and Hindmata area — knee-deep water
summary: Heavy rainfall causes waterlogging in Dadar-Hindmata junction. Central Railway services affected.
full_description: Hindmata junction, Mumbai's chronic flood spot, submerged again. Water rising to 3 feet. Pumps deployed but overwhelmed.

ai_analysis.risk_summary: Risk of electrocution from submerged wires
ai_analysis.recommended_action: Do NOT wade through floodwater. Use elevated routes.

title: Earthquake tremor felt in Palghar district — magnitude 3.8
summary: Mild earthquake tremor felt across Palghar and Vasai. No damage reported so far.
full_description: Seismological department confirms 3.8 magnitude earthquake with epicenter near Dahanu. Residents felt shaking for 5 seconds.

ai_analysis.risk_summary: Low structural damage risk, aftershocks possible
ai_analysis.recommended_action: Stay alert for aftershocks. Check building walls for cracks.

title: Goregaon slum fire — 200 shanties gutted, massive rescue underway
summary: Fire engulfs Dindoshi slum in Goregaon. 200+ shanties destroyed. Fire brigade from 4 stations deployed.
full_description: Fire started from a gas cylinder blast in Dindoshi area. High winds spread fire rapidly. No casualties confirmed yet.

ai_analysis.risk_summary: Massive displacement, potential gas cylinder explosions
ai_analysis.recommended_action: Evacuate nearby areas. Donate relief at designated centers.

title: Sea erosion threatens Versova beach — 10 houses at risk
summary: Rising sea levels and erosion threatening 10 coastal houses in Versova. BMC issues warning.
full_description: Coastal erosion during high tide has eaten away 15 feet of beach. 10 houses in danger zone. Residents advised to relocate temporarily.

ai_analysis.risk_summary: Gradual structural undermining of coastal structures
ai_analysis.recommended_action: Residents near coastline should prepare evacuation kits.

title: Train derailment near Kalyan junction — Western line disrupted
summary: Goods train derailed near Kalyan. Western line services suspended between Kalyan-Kasara.
full_description: A goods train carrying cement bags derailed at Kalyan junction. No casualties. Track clearance expected to take 6 hours.

ai_analysis.risk_summary: Major commuter disruption for 6+ hours
ai_analysis.recommended_action: Use ST buses or Metro Line 1 as alternative.

title: Power grid failure in South Mumbai — Colaba, Fort area in blackout
summary: Major power outage affecting Colaba, Fort, and CSMT area. BEST investigating transformer failure.
full_description: A transformer at Backbay substation failed causing cascading blackout across South Mumbai. Hospitals on backup generators.

ai_analysis.risk_summary: Hospital and traffic signal disruptions
ai_analysis.recommended_action: Charge devices. Check on elderly neighbors. Avoid elevators.

title: Dengue outbreak in Kurla — 85 cases in one week
summary: Alarming spike in dengue cases in Kurla West. BMC fumigation drives underway.
full_description: 85 confirmed dengue cases in Kurla West ward in just 7 days. BMC deploying door-to-door checks and fumigation.

ai_analysis.risk_summary: Vector-borne disease spread risk in monsoon
ai_analysis.recommended_action: Remove stagnant water. Use mosquito nets. Seek medical help for fever.

title: Nallah overflow in Jogeshwari — residents stranded on rooftops
summary: Poisar River nallah overflowed. 30 families stranded. NDRF boats deployed for rescue.
full_description: Heavy rain caused Poisar River to overflow in Jogeshwari West. Water entered ground floor homes. 30 families rescued via boats.

ai_analysis.risk_summary: Life-threatening flooding, disease risk from sewage mix
ai_analysis.recommended_action: Move to upper floors. Call 112 for rescue. Do NOT enter floodwater.
